reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound mechanism (defect sink action of Y2O3 dispersoids) that directly addresses radiation-induced precipitation while maintaining hardening, and it specifies a clear, testable intervention with measurable outcomes and a falsification experiment, whereas Hypothesis B relies on an unsupported claim that reducing high-angle grain boundary density suppresses precipitation and uses a lower irradiation temperature range that may not be fusion-relevant for this alloy.
